Name: Astral Elemental
Information:
**Astral Elementals**

Born from fissures in time and space within the Astral Sea, these elementals are best understood as anomalous holes in the universe, expressing themselves as a living mass of compressed space. They drift aimlessly near overlaps between exolunar space and the astral sea, and have a strong distaste for anything with a strong gravitational pull (such as ships, planets, or large creatures).

**Elemental Nature**

An elemental doesn’t require air, food, drink or sleep.

traits.name: Death Throes: Gravity Bubble
traits.description: When the elemental is killed, its body loses its structure and each creature within 10 feet of it is assaulted by a wave of force and must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are pushed back 10 feet (20 in a zero-gravity environment), are knocked prone and take 7 (1d12) force damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental uses its Dense Matter Strike twice.

actions.name: Dense Matter Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) force damage.

actions.name: Astral Overwhelm (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The elemental bends gravity around them, forcing each creature within 10 feet of them to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure they are blasted by the pulse of gravitational power, taking 20 (3d10 + 3) force damage, or half as much on a successful save. Creatures who fail are also restrained for 1 minute, locked in place by a gravitational anomaly, and repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.
